title: Upgraded
description: Upgraded is an interesting twist on a skill mod.
body:
## Upgraded
### Non-Magic Version Features
- Easy to configure chances, and durability (% or n)
- Using a tool/weapon will upgrade drop count, durability, or range, etc.
- Killing a boss will increase max health and attack damage.


### Magic Version Features
- Bosses drop attribute modifiers
- Slot upgrades (Max of 2 slots)
- Amethyst is used to move upgrades
- Steps:
  1. Tool in mainhand and Slot Upgrade in offhand
  2. Right click
  3. Tool in mainhand and Boss Upgrade in offhand
  4. Right click
- Supports DivineRPG.
